# Straconis Software Dev Nexus Launcher 0.3.2-alpha

Fixes category headings that displayed a question mark between a category and subcategory. Cards now display the supported slash separator, for example **HARDWARE / PROTOTYPES**.

## Downloads

- Windows per-user installer: `nexus-launcher-setup-0.3.2-alpha-windows-x86_64.exe`
- Windows portable ZIP: `nexus-launcher-windows-x86_64.zip`
- Linux x86_64: `nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
- Checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`

Users running 0.3.1-alpha can install this release using **UPDATE LAUNCHER**. Published 0.1.0-alpha and 0.3.0-alpha builds need a manual download because they predate the updater.

The update preserves catalogs, service settings, sign-in storage, and installed tools. Windows binaries are unsigned. macOS binaries are not included. This is an alpha release.
